# Dorothy Hodgkin — self-test quiz demo
qa = [
    ("What field did Dorothy Hodgkin work in?", "chemistry"),
    ("What is Dorothy Hodgkin known for?", "X-ray crystallography"),

    ("What is field?", "chemistry"),

    ("What is note?", "1964 Nobel; mapped penicillin and insulin"),
]

for i, (q, a) in enumerate(qa, 1):
    print(f"Q{i}: {q}")
    ans = input("Your answer: ").strip().lower()
    if ans and ans in a.lower():
        print("Correct.")
        score += 1

        print(f"Answer: {a}")
